mapper.sql: id, event_id, document_id, event_type, payload, status, retry_count, max_retry, last_error, created_at, next_retry_at, locked_at, completed_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_outbox (event_id, document_id, event_type, payload, status, retry_count, max_retry, last_error, created_at, next_retry_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{documentId}, #{eventType}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{maxRetry}, #{lastError}, NOW(), #{nextRetryAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_outbox WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM knowledge_outbox WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND next_retry_at <= #{beforeTime} ORDER BY next_retry_at ASC LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_outbox SET status = 'PROCESSING', locked_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE knowledge_outbox SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = NOW(), locked_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE knowledge_outbox SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, last_error = #{lastError}, locked_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE knowledge_outbox SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = 0, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, last_error = NULL, locked_at = NULL, completed_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'FAILED'
